name: Bitcoinica
rootCause: On 1 March 2012, Bitcoinica lost 43,554 BTC after attackers accessed its hot wallet by compromising its web hosting account at Linode. The hosting breach allowed the attacker to retrieve wallet keys and move funds. No detailed forensic or code analysis is published. Recovery was incomplete. The attacker gained access to the hosting provider’s administrative interface, used by Bitcoinica to run its service, permitting them to extract wallet keys and steal funds from the platform’s hot wallet.
